name: llama.cpp
qwen_support: GGUF quants of every Qwen generation, including MoE and VL via projector files.
gotchas: Vision needs a separate mmproj file; it is not in the main GGUF.
No speculative decoding without a separate draft model and --model-draft.
The widest hardware reach of any engine: runs on CPU-only, 24GB cards, and Apple Silicon alike.
caveats: Qwen3.8-27B on CUDA: builds around commit 221f0f6 (shallow clones reporting 'build 1') produce corrupted garbage completions at full speed with normal VRAM usage — silent corruption, no OOM or crash. Fixed by ece963f41 (~b10450): rebuild with -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=<arch> and Flash Attention on. (Forum report, WSL + RTX 3090, 2026-09.)
